unit.why: A single anecdote: a rich man comes to the Maggid, who angrily orders him to eat meat and drink mead daily, then explains to the hasidim the social logic behind the order.

stories.start_quote: ע״ש שבא אל המגיד זצ"ל גביר אחד
stories.summary_en: The Maggid berates a wealthy man who eats only bread and salt like a pauper and makes him promise to eat meat and drink mead daily, explaining that otherwise the rich man would think the poor can live on stones.
